data.explanation: This is a standard online-shop invoice for a purchase you already received (delivered 20 August 2026). You bought on account (Kauf auf Rechnung), so you now need to transfer the invoiced amount to the seller's account by the deadline shown, quoting the reference number so the payment is matched to your order. If you miss it, the seller can send a reminder (Mahnung) and eventually charge late fees or interest. Keep this invoice for warranty purposes; the seller's terms mention a statutory right of withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht) if you want to return the item, details of which are in their AGB online.
